scope: Bosnia and Herzegovina medical discovery — University of Tuzla Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: The Faculty of Medicine University of Tuzla states that teaching is delivered through medicine and health-studies programmes with close connection to clinical practice, research and professional development.
The Tuzla Canton Government announced in July 2026 that the Faculty completed accreditation of all its study programmes, including formal accreditation decisions for second-cycle programmes.
University of Tuzla announced a 2026 institutional reaccreditation decision confirming it meets prescribed higher-education and research quality standards.

holdReasons: No current official General Medicine programme fee, admissions timeline/requirements, language-of-instruction or foreign-student route was established.
The July 2026 public account specifically describes second-cycle programme accreditation; current first-cycle/integrated General Medicine accreditation scope needs direct confirmation.
A complete current clinical placement, accommodation and international-support evidence packet was not completed.
nextAction: Obtain University of Tuzla's current integrated General Medicine prospectus, international admissions/fee record and direct accreditation-scope confirmation before packaging.
